title: EFC human gate disposition
description: The human's binding disposition for a reviewed claim. A SEPARATE artifact from verdict.json by design: the verdict is frozen reviewer output and must never be mutated, so disposing a claim here leaves the reviewer words untouched. verdict_sha256 binds this gate to the exact verdict it disposes, so a gate cannot be silently re-pointed at a different verdict later. CLOSED (C10).

verdict_id.description: The verdict_id of the verdict this gate disposes.

verdict_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact verdict.json file this gate binds to. efc_review_gate.py refuses on mismatch.

status.description: The binding disposition. Written by a human, never by an agent.

approved_claims.description: The claim_ids the human approves. A promoted claim (declared_derived / declared_companion_upgrade) must appear here AND be grounded, or the release gate refuses.
